videos.title: AphA London Branch Meeting
videos.description:
AphA’s London branch was launched in 2017 and holds regular branch meetings where we:

showcase some of the great data and analytics work in London

network within the London data and analytics community

share knowledge and skills

hear from a variety of invited speakers

We aim to be as inclusive as possible – everyone’s contribution is welcome and encouraged. Please get in touch if you’d like to know more  – we’re keen to hear from organisations and people working with health and care data in the greater London area.

videos.title: AphA Competency Framework Survey Winners
videos.description:
AphA Competency Framework Survey March 2021, let's find out who the winners are!

Method

1. Survey was closed Friday 19th March 2021
2. AphA Board members were removed from entry list, although we do appreciate their efforts they aren't eligible to win 🙂
3. Duplicate entries were removed (only 1 email address)
4. Each email address was assigned a unique ticket reference number
5. We used this site to find our winner (randomly selected)
6. Winners will be contacted individually

Congratulations to all of our winners, and a huge thanks to over 200 colleagues who took part in the survey.

The Association of Professional Healthcare Analysts (AphA)
www.aphanalysts.org

videos.title: Association of Professional Healthcare Analysts (AphA) discussion - Paul Stroner and Rony Arafin
videos.description:
First of the AphA webinar series, in this video Rony Arafin, our Director of Digital Engagement speaks with Paul Stroner, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of AphA.

This video provides excellent insight and Paul speaks from his experience in detail about what AphA can offer, and how Analysts can engage with AphA to continue their personal and professional development in the analytical space. 

Please get in touch with us if you have comments/suggestions - info@aphanalysts.org

For more information, and how to join AphA, please visit our website - https://www.aphanalysts.org
